turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no weekday or weekend split for revenue, so I cannot give Saturday/Sunday against other-day averages without computing them myself; the closest figure it returned is total revenue of 16252.75 EUR over 17 August to 27 September 2026 (42 days, all days in the period). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
